The current and voltage output signals (current or voltage) from the tested transducers and the RiCT were routed directly to the DPM, a Yokogawa WT5000, for processing and comparison. Regarding its accuracy specifications for harmonic measurements, two key parameters must be distinguished. The base accuracy of the analog input modules in the 1 to 10 kHz band is ±(0.1% of reading + 0.05% of range). The accuracy of the harmonic measurement function inherently decreases in the upper frequency band.

The chosen instrument for this evaluation is the Yokogawa WT5000 (Yokogawa Electric Corporation, Tokyo, Japan) digital power meter [ 26 ].
